channel.title: The Grant Desk - Grants, Australia, weekly digest
channel.description: Paid open calls, fellowships and residencies in AI, tech, research, and digital and mixed-media arts, sorted into the right pile. Updated as new calls land on the desk. Filtered to: Grants, Australia, weekly digest. Released weekly: each Sunday's drop carries one entry per grant added in the week before it (Sunday to Saturday). A call that closes before its drop goes out is not sent; the website lists those.

item.title: Screen Australia: International Pitching Forums and Talent Labs (rolling)
item.description: Screen Australia · deadline Rolling / undated · Up to AUD 6,000 (or AUD 12,000 for teams) for events of up to 14 days; up to AUD 10,000 for talent labs or fellowships over 14 days and under 12 months; up to AUD 20,000 for programs over 12 months. One grant per 12-month period except in exceptional cases.

item.title: Screen Australia Future Leaders Delegation: BitSummit 2027 (Kyoto)
item.description: Screen Australia · deadline 05 Nov 2026 · AUD 6,000 per delegate towards flights, accommodation, event tickets, ground transportation and meals, plus covered travel costs for the pre-departure workshop and the opportunity to exhibit a game on the Australia stand. Up to eight delegates.

item.title: 1 new grant - week of 03 Aug 2026
item.description:
• Creative Australia: Arts Projects for Organisations (September 2026 round)
    https://creative.gov.au/investments-opportunities/arts-projects-organisations
    Creative Australia · deadline 01 Sep 2026 · AUD 20,000 to 100,000. No matching or co-financing requirement. No application fee. Organisational administrative costs should generally not exceed 10 percent of the total project budget or the application becomes less competitive.
